recommendation.text: The Board recommends that: (a) proposals for standards be evaluated in an empirical manner by clearly defining the operational requirements to be fulfilled; (b) in finalizing standards, market research be carried out with emphasis on the solution or benefit to be achieved; and (c) competitive bidding be the first line of approach in the larger interest of transparency in the Organization.
